message: Workouts can now be saved to Apple Health. Turn on Workouts under Settings › Apple Health › Log to Health, and Save on a finished workout writes it to Health as strength training. Deleting a workout takes it back out. The workout history also lists workouts other apps recorded in Health, such as a run or a class, marked From Health with the app's name. They are only shown, never counted in your records or stats. If you allowed Health access before this update, tap Health access in Settings › Apple Health once more so Health can ask about workouts.
